#### load required packages 
#library(GenomicFeatures)
library(DESeq2)
#library(tximport)
library(biomaRt)
library(apeglm)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
#library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
###### Load species raw count matrices
####### S. cerevisiae
Scer <- read_tsv(here("metadata", "Scer", "salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE))

####### C. glabrata 
Cgla <- read_tsv(here("metadata", "Cgla", "salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE))

####### C. albicans 
Calb <- read_tsv(here("metadata", "Calb", "salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE))

####### K. lactis 
Klac <- read_tsv(here("metadata", "Klac", "salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE))

#### Load species ID mapping data
load(here("RData_perSpecies_HOG_clean_07142025.RData"))
# str(all_species_data$ca)  # optionally inspect the structure


##### Create file paths for output
Scer_results <- here("results", "Scer")
Cgla_results <- here("results", "Cgla")
Calb_results <- here("results", "Calb")
Klac_results <- here("results", "Klac")

###### Directories for analysis/plots
Scer_plots <- here("plots", "Scer")
Cgla_plots <- here("plots", "Cgla")
Calb_plots <- here("plots", "Calb")
Klac_plots <- here("plots", "Klac")

############ load orthogroup data gile 
orthogroups <- read_tsv(here("annotationdata", "species_orthology.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE))


# Prepare count matrix
rownames(Calb) <- Calb$gene_id
Calb0060min <- grep("t0000|t0060", colnames(Calb), value = TRUE)
calb0060min <- Calb[, Calb0060min]
calb0060min <- as.data.frame(lapply(calb0060min, as.integer))
rownames(calb0060min) <- rownames(Calb)

# Sample metadata
conditions_calb <- ifelse(grepl("t0000", Calb0060min), "untreated", "treated")
calb_coldata <- data.frame(
  row.names = Calb0060min,
  condition = factor(conditions_calb, levels = c("untreated", "treated"))
)
calb_coldata$sample <- rep(paste0("sample", 1:4), each = 2)
calb_coldata$run <- rownames(calb_coldata)

# Create DESeqDataSet and collapse technical replicates
calbdds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = calb0060min,
                                  colData = calb_coldata,
                                  design = ~ condition)

calbdds_collapsed <- collapseReplicates(calbdds,
                                        groupby = calb_coldata$sample,
                                        run = calb_coldata$run)

colData(calbdds_collapsed)$condition <- colData(calbdds)[!duplicated(calb_coldata$sample), "condition"]

# Run DESeq and LFC shrinkage
calbdds_collapsed <- DESeq(calbdds_collapsed)
resLFCcalb <- lfcShrink(calbdds_collapsed,
                        coef = "condition_treated_vs_untreated",
                        type = "apeglm")

# Subset DEGs
resSigcalb  <- subset(resLFCcalb, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 2)
resSigcalb1 <- subset(resLFCcalb, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)

# Save result tables
write.csv(as.data.frame(resSigcalb),  file = file.path(Calb_results, "20250725Calb.LFCgt2.padjlt0.05.csv"))
write.csv(as.data.frame(resSigcalb1), file = file.path(Calb_results, "20250725Calb.LFCgt1.padjlt0.05.csv"))

# rlog and PCA
rld_calb <- rlog(calbdds_collapsed, blind = TRUE)
rld_mat_calb <- assay(rld_calb)

pca_calb <- prcomp(t(rld_mat_calb))
percentVar_calb <- round(100 * (pca_calb$sdev^2 / sum(pca_calb$sdev^2)))

calb_sample_info <- as.data.frame(colData(calbdds_collapsed))
calb_sample_info$sample <- rownames(calb_sample_info)

df_pca_calb <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_calb$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_calb$x[, 2],
  sample = rownames(pca_calb$x),
  group = calb_sample_info$condition
)

# Fixed PCA plot with autoscaling
CalbPCA1 <- ggplot(df_pca_calb, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - Calb t0000 vs t0060",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", percentVar_calb[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", percentVar_calb[2], "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm")
  )
CalbPCA1

ggsave(filename = file.path(Calb_plots, "PCA_Calb_t0000_vs_t0060.pdf"),
       plot = CalbPCA1, width = 8, height = 6)

# p-value histogram
#pdf(file.path(Calb_plots, "Histogram_pvalue_Calb.pdf"))
hist(resLFCcalb$pvalue, breaks = 50, col = "grey",
     main = "Distribution of Raw p-values",
     xlab = "p-values", ylab = "Frequency",
     cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.2)
#dev.off()

# adjusted p-value histogram
#pdf(file.path(Calb_plots, "Histogram_padj_Calb.pdf"))
hist(resLFCcalb$padj, breaks = 50, col = "grey",
     main = "Distribution of Adjusted p-values (FDR)",
     xlab = "FDR", ylab = "Frequency",
     cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.2)
#dev.off()

# MA plot
#pdf(file.path(Calb_plots, "MA_plot_Calb.pdf"))
plotMA(resLFCcalb, main = "MA Plot - Calb t0000 vs t0060", cex = 0.5)
#dev.off()

# Volcano plot
lfc_threshold <- 2
pval_threshold <- 0.05

tab_calb <- data.frame(
  logFC = resLFCcalb$log2FoldChange,
  negLogPval = -log10(resLFCcalb$padj)
)

sig_calb <- with(tab_calb, abs(logFC) > lfc_threshold & negLogPval > -log10(pval_threshold))

#pdf(file.path(Calb_plots, "Volcano_plot_Calb.pdf"))
plot(tab_calb, pch = 16, cex = 0.5,
     xlab = expression(bold(log[2]~fold~change)),
     ylab = expression(bold(-log[10]~FDR)),
     main = "Volcano Plot - Calb t0000 vs t0060")
points(tab_calb[sig_calb, ], col = "red", pch = 16, cex = 0.6)
abline(h = -log10(pval_threshold), col = "green3", lty = 2)
abline(v = c(-lfc_threshold, lfc_threshold), col = "blue", lty = 2)
#dev.off()
# Prepare count matrix
rownames(Klac) <- Klac$gene_id
Klac0060min <- grep("t0000|t0060", colnames(Klac), value = TRUE)
klac0060min <- Klac[, Klac0060min]
klac0060min <- as.data.frame(lapply(klac0060min, as.integer))
rownames(klac0060min) <- rownames(Klac)

# Sample metadata
conditions_klac <- ifelse(grepl("t0000", Klac0060min), "untreated", "treated")
klac_coldata <- data.frame(
  row.names = Klac0060min,
  condition = factor(conditions_klac, levels = c("untreated", "treated"))
)
klac_coldata$sample <- rep(paste0("sample", 1:4), each = 2)
klac_coldata$run <- rownames(klac_coldata)

# Create DESeqDataSet and collapse technical replicates

                                  colData = klac_coldata,
                                  design = ~ condition)

klacdds_collapsed <- collapseReplicates(klacdds,
                                        groupby = klac_coldata$sample,
                                        run = klac_coldata$run)

colData(klacdds_collapsed)$condition <- colData(klacdds)[!duplicated(klac_coldata$sample), "condition"]

# Run DESeq and LFC shrinkage

resLFCklac <- lfcShrink(klacdds_collapsed,
                        coef = "condition_treated_vs_untreated",
                        type = "apeglm")

# Subset DEGs
resSigklac  <- subset(resLFCklac, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 2)
resSigklac1 <- subset(resLFCklac, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)

# Save results
write.csv(as.data.frame(resSigklac),  file = file.path(Klac_results, "20250725Klac.LFCgt2.padjlt0.05.csv"))
write.csv(as.data.frame(resSigklac1), file = file.path(Klac_results, "20250725Klac.LFCgt1.padjlt0.05.csv"))

# rlog and PCA
rld_klac <- rlog(klacdds_collapsed, blind = TRUE)
rld_mat_klac <- assay(rld_klac)

pca_klac <- prcomp(t(rld_mat_klac))
percentVar_klac <- round(100 * (pca_klac$sdev^2 / sum(pca_klac$sdev^2)))

klac_sample_info <- as.data.frame(colData(klacdds_collapsed))

df_pca_klac <- data.frame(

  PC2 = pca_klac$x[, 2],
  sample = rownames(pca_klac$x),
  group = klac_sample_info$condition
)

# PCA plot (auto-scaled)
KlacPCA1 <- ggplot(df_pca_klac, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - Klac t0000 vs t0060",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", percentVar_klac[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", percentVar_klac[2], "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm")
  )
KlacPCA1
ggsave(filename = file.path(Klac_plots, "PCA_Klac_t0000_vs_t0060.pdf"),
       plot = KlacPCA1, width = 8, height = 6)

# Histograms

hist(resLFCklac$pvalue, breaks = 50, col = "grey",

# Count significant DEGs
sc_up   <- sum(resSigsc$log2FoldChange > 0)
sc_down <- sum(resSigsc$log2FoldChange < 0)

cg_up   <- sum(resSigcg$log2FoldChange > 0)
cg_down <- sum(resSigcg$log2FoldChange < 0)

calb_up   <- sum(resSigcalb$log2FoldChange > 0)
calb_down <- sum(resSigcalb$log2FoldChange < 0)

klac_up   <- sum(resSigklac$log2FoldChange > 0)
klac_down <- sum(resSigklac$log2FoldChange < 0)

# Combine into a data frame
deg_summary <- data.frame(
  Species = c("Scer", "Cgla", "Calb", "Klac"),
  Upregulated = c(sc_up, cg_up, calb_up, klac_up),
  Downregulated = c(sc_down, cg_down, calb_down, klac_down)
)
deg_summary$Total <- deg_summary$Upregulated + deg_summary$Downregulated

print(deg_summary)

# Convert to long format
deg_long <- deg_summary |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
               names_to = "Direction", values_to = "Count")

# Bar plot
p.sig.Degs <- ggplot(deg_long, aes(x = Species, y = Count, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "tomato", "Downregulated" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(title = "Differentially Expressed Genes by Species",
       y = "Significant DEGs (|LFC| > 2)",
       x = "Species") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
p.sig.Degs
ggsave("/Users/jayelazuno/Desktop/EvoPhosphoOmics/plots/Sig.DEGs.species.pdf", 
       plot = p.sig.Degs, width = 8, height = 6)
